author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before read as a mortar-and-pestle blob: a thick Y over a bowl, with no thumb. Redrawn on SQUARE: index (front) and middle (back) fingers on 1:2 bands with r5 tips, crossing so the back finger hides behind the front one, the curled fingers as a rounded knuckle at the right, a crease line where the index meets the palm, and the thumb extended up-left on a 2:1 band from the web, with its r5 tip at the x=6 edge. Reads as crossed fingers with an open thumb at 48 in both themes.
omissions: The two curled fingers are merged into one knuckle shoulder (no room for a divider at 8-unit spacing).
